newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt Nile Match profits down 34 pct in H1.
newsitem.headline: Egypt Nile Match profits down 34 pct in H1.

text.p: Partially privatised Nile Match and Prefabricated Houses said on Tuesday its net after-tax profits declined 33.9 percent in the first half of 1996/7 to 798,000 pounds ($235,000) from 1.21 million in the same period of the previous year. The year ends on June 30.
The firm made profits of 10.68 million in the whole of 1995/6.
Turnover in the period July-December 1996 shrank slightly to 31.728 million pounds from 31.875 million in the same period of 1995/6.
Shareholders' funds went up marginally to 37.840 million pounds on December 31, 1996, from 37.798 million on June 30, 1996.
The state sold about 65 percent of Nile Match's two million shares to private investors last August at 27 pounds a share. The stock closed on Thursday, before a four-day holiday, at 28.99 pounds.
